I couldn't confirm the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team to say so.

I checked #central-team and the shared files, which are things Pree can see herself. Neither has anything on Brackenwater Freight Co.: no account folder, contract or CRM entry. I didn't use search, since its results include conversations she isn't in.

In the reply I told her the date is noted as unverified and won't be treated as the renewal date yet. I also suggested she ask the account owner to check it against the contract, since nothing I can see shows who that is.
